name: Novanta
outlook:
What Novanta says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: revenue, adjusted EBITDA and EPSFor the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects GAAP revenue to be in the range of $306 million to $312 million, reflecting reported revenue growth of more than 18%. The Company also expects Adjusted EBITDA to be in the range of $76 million to $79 million and Adjusted Diluted EPS to be in the range of $0.91 to $0.96 per diluted share, or 0% to 5% growth. The Company’s guidance assumes no significant changes in foreign exchange rates.
  • Full year 2026: revenue, adjusted EBITDA and EPSFor the full year 2026, the Company now expects GAAP revenue to be in the range of $1,135 million to $1,140 million, reflecting reported growth of approximately 16%. The company expects Adjusted EBITDA to be in the range of $274 million to $277 million, and Adjusted Diluted EPS to be in the range of $3.66 to $3.71 per diluted share, or 11% to 13% growth. The Company’s guidance assumes no significant changes in foreign exchange rates.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 9, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
